name: Auto ADX
summary: This EA uses the ADX (Average Directional Index) indicator to identify trend strength and direction, automatically opening buy or sell positions when the ADX signals a strong trending market. It combines DI+ and DI- crossovers with ADX threshold filters to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The system manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用ADX（平均趋向指数）指标来识别趋势强度和方向，当ADX信号表明市场处于强趋势时自动开仓做多或做空。它结合DI+和DI-交叉与ADX阈值过滤，沿当前趋势方向入场交易。系统通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ADX指标判断趋势强度和方向，当ADX值高于设定阈值时认为市场处于趋势状态，此时根据DI+和DI-的交叉信号决定入场方向。入场条件为DI+上穿DI-且ADX高于阈值时做多，DI-上穿DI+且ADX高于阈值时做空，ADX低于阈值时不交易以避免震荡市。出场条件包括达到止盈目标、触发止损或反向交叉信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式，部分版本支持加仓逻辑。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺少追踪止损和分批平仓等高级风控机制，整体风险控制依赖于固定止损止盈的设置。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ADX indicator to assess trend strength and direction, entering trades only when ADX exceeds a configured threshold indicating a trending market. Entry conditions require DI+ crossing above DI- for buy signals and DI- crossing above DI+ for sell signals, both filtered by the ADX threshold to avoid choppy sideways markets. Exit conditions include reaching the take profit target, hitting the stop loss level, or closing on an opposite DI crossover signal. Position sizing typically uses fixed lot sizes or an ATR-based dynamic calculation, though some implementations include basic money management options. The risk management relies primarily on fixed stop loss and take profit values, lacking advanced features like trailing stops, partial position closure, or equity-based position scaling which limits its adaptability in volatile market conditions.

parameters.name: ADX_Threshold
parameters.description: ADX趋势强度阈值，高于此值才开仓
parameters.description_en: ADX trend strength threshold, only open positions above this value

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 使用ADX过滤震荡行情，避免在无趋势市场中频繁交易造成亏损
DI+/DI-交叉结合ADX阈值的逻辑清晰，信号明确易于理解和优化
参数可配置性强，交易者可根据不同品种和周期调整ADX阈值和止损止盈
pros_en: ADX filter effectively avoids choppy markets, preventing frequent losing trades in sideways conditions
DI+/DI- crossover combined with ADX threshold provides clear and unambiguous signals easy to understand and optimize
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to adjust ADX threshold and stop levels for different instruments and timeframes
cons: ADX是滞后指标，信号延迟可能导致入场点不够理想，错过趋势初期
缺乏追踪止损机制，在强趋势中无法锁定浮动利润，可能由盈转亏
固定止损止盈不能适应不同市场波动率，在低波动和高波动时期风险收益比不一致
cons_en: ADX is a lagging indicator causing delayed entries that may miss the early stage of trends
Lack of trailing stop means floating profits in strong trends cannot be locked in, potentially turning winners into losers
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to varying market volatility, leading to inconsistent risk-reward ratios across different volatility regimes
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离以提高适应性
加入追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时逐步锁定利润，避免大幅回撤
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility for better adaptability
Implement a trailing stop feature to progressively lock in profits as the trend extends, avoiding significant drawdowns

risk_points: 止损默认值为0，如果不手动设置则交易无止损保护，风险极大
缺乏持仓数量检查和重复开仓防护，可能在同一信号上多次开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差时段入场会显著影响盈亏比
risk_points_en: Default stop loss value is 0, meaning trades have no stop protection if not manually configured, posing extreme risk
Lacks position count check and duplicate entry prevention, potentially opening multiple positions on the same signal
No spread filter allows entries during high-spread periods which significantly degrades risk-reward ratio
